ANNEX I - TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION
Sensors shall measure water level with an accuracy of +/- 5 mm over a range of 0 to 10 m.
Data shall be transmitted every 10 minutes to the Agency's existing data platform.
The Supplier shall provide a warranty of 24 months from final acceptance.
Installation at the four harbours must be completed within 6 months of contract signature.
